title: Stave Finding Contract v1
description: Contract schema for individual Stave findings. Each finding represents a single control violation detected for a specific asset. The shape mirrors internal/adapters/output/dto.FindingDTO; consumers can rely on every documented field appearing exactly as named.

finding_id.title: Finding ID
finding_id.description: Stable per-finding identifier emitted by the engine; identical across runs for the same (control, asset) pair while the finding is open.

control_id.title: Control ID
control_id.description: Unique identifier of the control that was violated (e.g., CTL.STORAGE.PUBLIC.001).

control_name.title: Control Name
control_name.description: Human-readable name of the violated control.

control_description.title: Control Description
control_description.description: Detailed description of the unsafe condition detected by the control.

control_severity.title: Control Severity
control_severity.description: Severity tier (critical | high | medium | low | info | none). Lowercase canonical names matching controldef.Severity.

control_compliance.title: Control Compliance Mapping
control_compliance.description: Map from compliance framework name to citation (e.g. "hipaa": "§164.312(b)").

control_compliance_ccm_v4.title: CCM v4 Citations
control_compliance_ccm_v4.description: Cloud Security Alliance Cloud Controls Matrix v4 citations for this control.

asset_id.title: Asset ID
asset_id.description: Unique identifier of the asset that violated the control.

asset_type.title: Asset Type
asset_type.description: Type of the asset (e.g., storage_bucket, iam_role).

asset_vendor.title: Asset Vendor
asset_vendor.description: Cloud vendor or platform of the asset (e.g., aws, gcp, azure).

source.title: Source Reference
source.description: Optional reference to the source file and line where the asset was defined.

evidence.title: Violation Evidence
evidence.description: Temporal and causal evidence supporting this finding.

remediation.title: Remediation Guidance
remediation.description: Guidance for remediating this specific violation.

fix_plan.title: Fix Plan
fix_plan.description: Machine-readable deterministic fix plan for supported finding classes.

exposure.title: Exposure Classification
exposure.description: Classifies who can reach the asset and how.

type.title: Exposure Type
type.description: Kind of exposure (e.g., public_read, public_write, resource_takeover).

principal_scope.title: Principal Scope
principal_scope.description: Audience that gains access (e.g., global, authenticated, cross_account).

exposure_score.title: Exposure Score
exposure_score.description: Derived score factoring asset reachability and audience scope.

score_breakdown.title: Score Breakdown
score_breakdown.description: Per-component decomposition of the finding's risk score (severity, exposure, dwell, chain bonus, etc.). Shape mirrors risk.ScoreBreakdown.

posture_drift.title: Posture Drift Classification
posture_drift.description: Classifies the temporal behavior pattern of the violation, computed from the asset timeline.

chain_membership.title: Chain Membership
chain_membership.description: Chains this finding contributes to. Non-empty when the finding is part of one or more active threat chains.

sla_breached.title: SLA Breached
sla_breached.description: True when an SLA deadline applies to this finding and has been crossed.

sla_deadline_hours.title: SLA Deadline (hours)
sla_deadline_hours.description: Configured SLA deadline in hours. Null when no SLA policy applies.

sla_overdue_hours.title: SLA Overdue (hours)
sla_overdue_hours.description: Hours past the SLA deadline at evaluation time. Null when not overdue or no SLA applies.

sla_escalated_severity.title: SLA-Escalated Severity
sla_escalated_severity.description: Severity after SLA-driven escalation, if the policy mandates escalation on breach.

sla_policy_source.title: SLA Policy Source
sla_policy_source.description: Identifier of the SLA policy file or profile that produced the deadline.

reasoning_trace.title: Reasoning Trace
reasoning_trace.description: Per-clause reasoning trail showing which predicate expressions matched and the observed values that triggered them.

remediation_context.title: Remediation Context
remediation_context.description: Asset identity, violation reasoning, structured changes, and parameterised command — packaged for downstream remediation generators.

alternatives.title: Alternative Tool Coverage
alternatives.description: Equivalent checks in other detection tools, for cross-tool calibration.

scope_tags.title: Scope Tags
scope_tags.description: Operational scope tags carried from the control (e.g. environment, business unit).

defect.title: Defect Class
defect.description: Causal defect category (e.g. exposure, integrity, availability).

infection.title: Infection Class
infection.description: How the unsafe configuration spread (e.g. inherited_default, user_misconfig, terraform_template).

archetype.title: Finding Archetype
archetype.description: Higher-level archetype the finding maps to (e.g. public_storage, iam_overscope).

delta.title: Fix Paths
delta.description: Independent fix paths — each entry describes one property the operator can change to remediate.

contributing_fact_ids.title: Contributing Fact IDs
contributing_fact_ids.description: SIR fact_ids whose Subject equals this finding's asset_id. Each id matches the `fact_id` in `stave export-sir --format jsonl` and the `;; fact_id:` comment in `stave export-sir --format smt2`, providing a grep-traceable link from a CEL finding back to the specific observation properties and SMT-LIB assertions that describe the same asset.

sourceRef.title: Source Reference
sourceRef.description: Reference to a source file and line for traceability.

line.title: Source Line Number
line.description: Line number in the source file.

evidence.title: Temporal Evidence
evidence.description: Temporal evidence proving the duration and nature of the unsafe condition. Field names mirror EvidenceDTO JSON tags exactly; legacy first_seen_unsafe is now first_unsafe_at.

first_unsafe_at.title: First Unsafe At
first_unsafe_at.description: UTC timestamp (RFC 3339) of the earliest observation snapshot where the asset was in an unsafe state.

last_seen_unsafe_at.title: Last Seen Unsafe At
last_seen_unsafe_at.description: UTC timestamp of the most recent observation snapshot where the asset was in an unsafe state.

unsafe_duration_hours.title: Unsafe Duration Hours
unsafe_duration_hours.description: Hours the asset has been continuously unsafe, computed first_unsafe_at → evaluation time.

threshold_hours.title: Threshold Hours
threshold_hours.description: The max-unsafe threshold (in hours) that was exceeded to trigger this violation.

exposure_window_count.title: Exposure Window Count
exposure_window_count.description: Number of distinct exposure windows recorded for this asset within the recurrence-policy lookback.

window_days.title: Lookback Window (days)
window_days.description: Lookback period used to compute exposure_window_count, in days.

recurrence_threshold.title: Recurrence Limit
recurrence_threshold.description: Recurrence-policy threshold above which exposure_window_count constitutes a violation.

misconfigurations.title: Misconfigurations
misconfigurations.description: Per-property mismatch records — what the predicate examined and what it observed.

temporal_risk.title: Temporal Risk Description
temporal_risk.description: Human-readable description of the temporal risk (e.g. "Unsafe for 24h (threshold: 12h)").

sourceEvidence.title: Source Evidence
sourceEvidence.description: Identity-statement and resource-grantee context attached to evidence.

unsafe_value.title: Unsafe Value
unsafe_value.description: Value the control treats as unsafe — type varies by control.

remediation.title: Remediation Guidance
remediation.description: Remediation guidance for resolving this violation.

action.title: Parameterised Action
action.description: RemediationSpec.Action template parameterised to the specific asset (ARN/region/account substituted). Empty when the underlying control has no templated command. Renamed from the legacy 'command' wire name.

postureDrift.title: Posture Drift
postureDrift.description: Temporal behaviour pattern derived from the asset timeline. Field name `exposure_window_count` matches the PostureDriftDTO JSON tag exactly (was `episode_count` in the v0 schema).

exposure_window_count.title: Exposure Window Count
exposure_window_count.description: Total number of exposure windows (closed + currently open).

chainMembership.title: Chain Membership Entry
chainMembership.description: One chain membership for the finding.

matchedClause.title: Matched Predicate Clause
matchedClause.description: One predicate clause that contributed to the finding's truthness, with operator and observed/expected values.

alternative.title: Alternative Tool Coverage Entry
alternative.description: Equivalent check in another detection tool.

deltaPath.title: Delta Fix Path
deltaPath.description: One independent property change the operator can make to remediate.
